course_name_original: SISTEMAS CONSTRUCTIVOS Y EJECUCION DE OBRAS
course_name_en: CONSTRUCTIVE SYSTEMS AND EXECUTION OF WORKS

learning_outcomes.text: Apply acquired knowledge to identify, formulate and solve problems in broad contexts, being able to integrate them by working in multidisciplinary teams.
Understand the impact of engineering on the environment, the sustainable development of society and the importance of working in a professional and responsible environment.
Communicate knowledge and conclusions, both orally and in writing, to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Possess learning skills that allow continuous study throughout life for adequate professional development.
Incorporate ICT and industrial engineering technologies and tools into professional activities.
Know and apply basic science and technology knowledge to the practice of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge and capacity for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.
Ability to control projects and execution. Knowledge of the behavior of different joints and their execution.
Knowledge of the different execution systems and organization of constructive processes.
Ability to design, direct works and build.

syllabus_topics: Topography. The terrain and its representation
The terrain in the selection of a building site
assessment_rules: Each activity is graded out of 10 points. To pass the course, a minimum weighted average grade of 5 out of 10 is required. In the ordinary call, students who do not pass or do not attend the two intermediate controls or practices may take a final control of the entire subject, where the grade for this test will be 100% of the course grade; to pass, a minimum of 5 points out of 10 is required on this test. For the extraordinary call, only one written test will be conducted, whose grade will be 100% of the final grade; to pass, a minimum of 5 points out of 10 is required on this test.
